    • Editorial policy

    Whiterun in the centre tundra, Solitude on the north coast, Riften in the south-east Rift

    Skyrim sits on the world map of The Elder Scrolls V: Skyrim. Whiterun occupies the central tundra. Solitude and the Blue Palace hold the Haafingar coast. Windhelm and the Palace of Kings sit on the White River. Markarth cuts the Reach. Riften and Mistveil Keep close the south-east. Winterhold, Dawnstar, Morthal, and Falkreath keep the remaining holds. Riverwood sits below the Throat of the World. Solstheim opens across the sea: Raven Rock on the south-west shore, the Temple of Miraak inland, the All-Maker stones on the north ice.

    Cities, towns, caves, Nordic ruins, Dwarven halls, forts, dragon lairs, standing stones, and shrines stay on. Doors, ore veins, books, world encounters, and crafting stations start hidden so the holds stay readable. The Maps tab opens Solstheim, with All-Maker stones and the Temple of Miraak.
